edges.parent_basis:
The act names what it follows: variations and additions have been introduced so
that this new edition may answer to the documents published since ITS FIRST
EDITION OF 1970. It names the 1970 edition rather than the 1971 reprint, and the
edge is drawn to the reprint because that is the state the line had reached; the
act reaches past it to the edition, and that is recorded here rather than
smoothed away.
